name: Shinigamikko to Asobou!
source:
The adventure story of a lilim apprentice's first job.
She's a shinigami, an eater of souls. But she came to attack the protagonist knowing a thing or two about the higher value of sperm!! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE088726.html]DLsite english[/url]]

一个梦魔学徒的初出茅庐冒险故事。她是一个死神，吞噬灵魂的存在。但她来袭击主人公时，对精液的更高价值略知一二！！
